mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the risk-free rate in equity valuation models, increasing the present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals an imminent monetary policy tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 3.0%

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high housing starts (HOUST) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation and impending policy tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1416.0 and GDPC1 exceeds 17302.511

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods where INDPRO is above 100

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.5% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 7.5%

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS both increase

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation, low rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the central bank faces a policy dilemma, causing market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%
